notes.title: Official Release Date Announced! “Divine Sin Descends” Lands on July 17
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for your patience!

“Divine Sin Descends” is finally set to officially arrive on July 17!


First and foremost, we sincerely thank all the players who joined the demo, provided feedback, and have continually supported us! Since the game was first revealed, we’ve received so much anticipation and attention—which not only brings us joy but also fuels our motivation.



The upcoming release of “Divine Sin Descends” Parts 1 + 2 is now complete.
At this stage, our overseas publisher Jast is conducting the final polish on the text and stability testing. Jast is known for the high quality of its visual novels and is particularly meticulous about text quality. They take this project very seriously and want extra time to refine the writing.

Because we’re aiming for a simultaneous global launch, we ask for your understanding and a little patience. We deeply apologize—on behalf of both us and Jast—for any delay caused.



Meanwhile, our team and X.D. will continue refining the details during this remaining time to deliver “Divine Sin Descends” in the best possible condition to players worldwide.


Please join us this summer on July 17 to witness the arrival of this game!

notes.title: The Coming of God's Sin Update Announcement & Community Events
notes.notes:
The trial version of "Sin Comes of God" has now been updated. 

This update has newly installed the "Find Secrets" system gameplay, with a total of 20 secrets installed. I look forward to your exploration and reasoning. 

In addition, the community has opened new activities, and there are also Hao Sijia plastic cards and special prizes waiting for you!
